title.zh: 台灣房地產 2026：房價所得比、房貸、青安與發展歷程
title.en: Taiwan Housing 2026: Prices, Mortgages and Policy

description.zh: 2026 年全國房價所得比 9.47 倍（115 年第 1 季）。整理八十年住宅政策與青安貸款三代條件，附房貸試算、負擔自查等四個工具，數字都附官方來源。
description.en: Taiwan's price-to-income ratio was 9.47 in 2026 Q1. Eighty years of housing policy, the Qing-An loan, and four calculators, all sourced.

title.zh: 房貸試算 2026：本息、本金、寬限期與青安 3.0 對照
title.en: Taiwan Mortgage Calculator 2026: Qing-An 3.0 Step Rates

description.zh: 輸入貸款金額、年限與利率，算出每月還款、總利息與還款曲線。可切換青安 3.0 階梯利率與一般房貸對照，支援寬限期、分段利率與提前還款。
description.en: Enter loan amount, term and rate to get the monthly payment, total interest and repayment curve. Compare Youth Loan 3.0 step rates with a normal loan.

title.zh: 房價負擔能力自查 2026：房貸負擔率與房價所得比
title.en: Home Affordability Check 2026: Burden and Price-to-Income

description.zh: 輸入家庭收入與房價，算出你的房貸負擔率與房價所得比，對照內政部四級標準與 22 縣市最新官方數字（115 年第 1 季）。
description.en: Enter household income and home price to see your mortgage burden ratio and price-to-income ratio against official 22-county figures (2026 Q1).

title.zh: 青安 3.0 資格自查 2026：年齡、所得與房價上限
title.en: Qing-An 3.0 Eligibility Check 2026: Age, Income, Price Cap

description.zh: 依財政部 2026 年 8 月上路的青安 3.0 條文，逐條比對年齡、年所得 200 萬、房價上限與限貸一次，列出可申請額度並附條文原文。
description.en: Check age, NT$2 million income limit, price caps and the one-loan rule against Youth Loan 3.0, with the eligible ceiling and original wording.

title.zh: 買房還是租房試算 2026：用你的假設比較淨資產
title.en: Rent vs Buy Calculator 2026: Net Worth on Your Assumptions

description.zh: 輸入房價、租金、利率與你自己對房價和報酬的假設，逐年比較買與租兩條路的淨資產，所有假設都看得到、改得動。
description.en: Enter price, rent, rates and your own assumptions about prices and returns to compare net worth by year; every assumption is editable.
